visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women are seated cross-legged on a light wood floor in a brightly lit indoor space. The woman on the left wears a black beanie, a black sweater vest over a striped blue shirt, and baggy denim jeans. The woman on the right wears a cream and maroon Kodak-branded quarter-zip sweatshirt. They face the camera and talk enthusiastically with frequent hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a closer framing as the woman on the right picks up a bright orange retro-style telephone receiver and puts it to her ear, smiling broadly. The background shows storage shelves with various items. (3) The woman on the left holds a signature yellow Kodak cardboard box and a pink baseball cap. She demonstrates the cap's material and points to the box, while the lighting remains natural and bright from a nearby window. (4) A close-up shot features a white rectangular box containing five pairs of rolled-up white socks with different colored branding labels. The woman on the left holds the box steady for the camera to see. (5) In a subsequent phase, the woman on the left holds a white glass candle jar with a silver lid, typical of the Jo Malone brand. She gestures with her fingers near her face while explaining its scent. (6) The woman on the right presents two large stainless steel Stanley tumblers—one light grey and one charcoal grey. She holds them side-by-side to compare their sizes. (7) A transition shows the woman on the right pointing to the red 'Kodak' logo on her chest while laughing. The woman on the left adjusts her beanie and looks at the camera. (8) The woman on the right holds up a Lady Gaga vinyl record sleeve for the album 'Born This Way,' featuring a high-contrast grayscale photo of the artist. (9) The woman on the left demonstrates various pieces of jewelry, including rings on her fingers and a silver bracelet on her wrist, bringing them closer to the lens for detail. (10) The final phase shows both women back in a wide shot, waving and gesturing as they conclude their gift recommendation list, with warm sunlight casting soft shadows on the wall behind them.
